discarded_trials: A ladder that shared cpuset 8-11 with another unit's harness; a kimi comparison begun before the candidate source was final; a batch of rungs that ran after the fixture server was killed. All were repeated rather than reported.
fixture_restart: The fixture server was killed once mid-session and restarted from unchanged source, so the fixture revision is the same for every retained trial.
harness_arguments: defaults for --timeout (240) and --grace (10); no retained rung used a grace above the harness's 45-second watchdog margin
integrity: No retained rung recorded watchdog_killed, a cleanup survivor, a turn without a result, or a pidfd wait fallback.
orphans: Two processes of this unit's own, survivors of a batch killed when the fixture server died, sat in scopes pinned to 0-3 for about eighty minutes at near-zero CPU and were reaped before the final runs.
resource_group: /sys/fs/cgroup/hmzbench/u16 via hmzbench-in: cpuset.cpus 8-11 exclusive (cgroup v2 cpuset, not task affinity), cpu.max 400000/100000, memory.max 16 GiB, memory.swap.max 0. The harness recorded valid_4cpu_16gib true for every rung.
serialization: One run.py at a time; hmzbench-in refuses to start while the group holds a process.
speed_floor: Complete-turn latency, from turn submission to the result and startup included, at most 2x the serial control of the same source, for cold and warm p50 and p95 alike. Throughput is not the reading: N sessions always finish more work than one.
superseded_condition: Earlier figures from this unit were taken on cpuset 0-3 with taskset plus a systemd user scope, while sibling units' benchmarks held neighbouring quads. They are systematically pessimistic and are not reported. Every backend cleared a higher width once the cores were exclusive: claude 6 to 7, dsh 8 to 12, mimo 5 to 8, opencode 4 to 6.
validity_checks_retained: All items correct, a fresh execution proof per turn, immutable task inputs, the turn-two marker recalled from the conversation alone, exactly one result, at least one tool event, no cleanup survivors, no watchdog kill.
